payload.blocks: Only phase 5 step 4 (status: withdrawn on plans/261113-0124-docos-retrospective-claim-units/plan.md). The rest of phase 5 lands without it.
payload.headline: The replaced draft plan 261113-0124 cannot be set withdrawn: the pre-commit legacy-plan gate refuses it

parts.cause: The draft is a legacy plan with no 'contract: plan-v1' marker; the gate refuses any staged legacy plan, and adding the marker means writing body sections the draft never had. Same cause as q-lb3rw5lo4u.

options.does: The draft keeps its status; the backlog row and the new plan already name the new plan as the carrier
options.gain: No edit to a legacy plan; phase 5 lands now
options.harm: The draft still reads as open to someone who opens it directly
options.label: Leave the draft unchanged

options.does: A unit adds the marker and the missing body sections, then sets withdrawn
options.gain: The draft is marked withdrawn as planned
options.harm: Writes body sections into a plan nobody will run
options.label: Migrate the draft to plan-v1, then withdraw

options.cost: A new item outside this plan
options.does: A separate backlog item changes the pre-commit gate so a status-only change to a legacy plan passes
options.gain: Fixes both this and q-lb3rw5lo4u for every later plan
options.harm: Changes a gate outside this plan
options.label: Let the gate accept withdrawn legacy plans

scope.allows: Deciding phase 5 step 4 and, if chosen, opening the gate item

parts.what: Phase 5 must set the old draft plan to status withdrawn with one line naming its replacement. Every commit that stages that plan file is refused by the pre-commit plan contract gate.
